messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: 0.6-20 has been released on CRAN
parts:
Dear lavaan users,

A new version of lavaan (0.6-20) has been released. Apart from many small fixes, this release has two main features:

1) lavaan now fully supports 'composite-based SEM'; see the arxiv paper here:

https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.06112

2) local sam (using the sam() function) has been extended and now supports higher-order factors, twostep.robust standard errors, local standard errors, and more.

When se = "local" is used with local sam, it is almost 100% local. This is not the default yet (in 0.6-20), but we hope to have this ready for 0.6-21.

Yves.

--
Yves Rosseel
Department of Data Analysis, Ghent University
